prescriptions.title: Begelman, Rossi & Armitage (2008)
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2.1-2.4; Eqs 1-14
prescriptions.assumptions: Radiation dominated convective envelope; low BH/envelope mass; unresolved central accretion flow
prescriptions.validity: Hot optically thick envelope; do not apply the analytic photosphere scalings as an EOS
prescriptions.variables_units: L erg/s, M g, rho g/cm^3, P dyn/cm^2; alpha dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Eq 3 is a selectable luminosity law. Fixed excision geometry is an additional QStarS approximation, not BRA equilibrium replication.

prescriptions.title: Ball et al. (2011)
prescriptions.assumptions: BH-only Bondi radius; rho~r^-3/2 cavity; loaded polytrope
prescriptions.validity: Reference n=2,3,4 polytropes; complete stellar tracks require different microphysics
prescriptions.variables_units: xi and phi dimensionless; accretion g/s; radius cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Eq 15 prints 4pi despite Eq 12 plus rB=2GM/cs^2 implying 16pi. Preserve printed mode; do not blend with QUEST. Table 1 stored as unreplicated target.

prescriptions.title: Dotan, Rossi & Shaviv (2011)
prescriptions.assumptions: Porous radiation-driven sonic boundary; empirical wind function W; photon-tiring cap
prescriptions.validity: Only effective launch prescription, not a solved porous atmosphere/wind
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot g/s, L erg/s, gas sound speed cm/s, W dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use gas isothermal sound speed; gamma<=1 gives zero. Wind enthalpy and energy to escape are separately charged.

prescriptions.title: Ball (2012) thesis
prescriptions.reference_location: Chapters 2-5; Bondi and CDAF/ADAF boundaries
prescriptions.assumptions: Boundary choice changes the evolutionary sequence and its mass limit
prescriptions.validity: No single universal quasi-star BH mass limit
prescriptions.variables_units: M g, r cm, thermodynamic quantities CGS
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Inspected boundary discussion and contents; thesis has 145 pages and was not audited line by line. Alternatives must remain explicit.

prescriptions.title: Fiacconi & Rossi (2016)
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2.1-2.2; Eqs 12-22,25; Figures 2 and 4
prescriptions.assumptions: Stationary spherical radiation-dominated wind; radiation enthalpy advection
prescriptions.validity: Gas pressure negligible and wind base optically thick
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot g/s, L erg/s, specific Bernoulli energy erg/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Inward integration retains radiative, advected, kinetic and gravitational energy. Base Mach is explicitly 0.8 +/- 0.05, as in the paper; no gas sonic critical-point selection is claimed. Figure 4 vector paths retain calibration uncertainty and discrepancies; evolving-envelope coupling remains open.

prescriptions.title: Coughlin & Begelman (2024)
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2-3; Eqs 2-7,11-21; Figs 1,3,4
prescriptions.assumptions: Radiation-dominated saturated inner convection matched to n=3 outer envelope
prescriptions.validity: Dimensionless static structure; thin radiative layer approximation
prescriptions.variables_units: xi, m, Ki dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Direct ODE integration distinguishes corrected Bondi and saturated families. Printed Ki=.46554 and mBH/Mi=.6321 correspond to x_tilde=1, not the stated entropy minimum near 1.015. Retain both and document discrepancy.

prescriptions.title: Campbell, Santarelli & Caplan (2025)
prescriptions.reference_location: Eqs 1-5; Fig 1; public code
prescriptions.assumptions: MESA EOS/opacity, ML1 convection, cavity, TOV correction
prescriptions.validity: Full published run depends on MESA r24.03.1
prescriptions.variables_units: CGS; epsilon, eta dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Early note Eq 3 lacks (1-epsilon) while using a BH growth convention. Later article and source code have it. No silent normalization correction.

prescriptions.title: Santarelli et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections V-VI; Eqs 8,11-13; upstream implementation
prescriptions.assumptions: Convection-limited accretion with explicit radiative efficiency; MESA full tracks
prescriptions.validity: Luminosity law does not reproduce its moving cavity or saturated-convection boundary
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot_BH=(1-epsilon)mdot_rest g/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Named quest2025_eq11 uses 16pi and distinct rest/BH rates; upstream HEAD inspected at 671eb9b898b28c0d02a6a2455dacc0f5b269e280.

prescriptions.title: Hassan et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2.1, Eqs 5-6; Appendix A cubic
prescriptions.assumptions: Self-consistent Bondi radius including rho~r^-3/2 cavity
prescriptions.validity: Below critical mass, choose small positive radius continuous as MBH tends to zero
prescriptions.variables_units: rho g/cm^3, cs cm/s, N dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Solve Appendix A cubic directly for stability near zero BH mass; verified equivalent to printed Eq 6. An initial factor-of-two audit suspicion was retracted (Report 4). Full ~0.33 evolutionary limit remains unreplicated.

prescriptions.title: Cantiello et al. (2025/2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2.2, nonadiabatic GYRE analysis
prescriptions.assumptions: GYRE 8.1 nonadiabatic radial modes with fixed inner displacement and MESA microphysics
prescriptions.validity: Linear stability results cannot be inferred from nonlinear solver failures
prescriptions.variables_units: Eigenfrequency complex; periods time; growth rates inverse time
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: QStarS Mach or solver stops are domain/numerical exits, not a pulsational-instability diagnosis.

prescriptions.title: Roman-Garza et al. (2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2; Appendix A; Table B.1
prescriptions.assumptions: Cold net mass gain; MESA 25.10.1; nuclear evolution and GR progenitor; late extrapolation
prescriptions.validity: Net-gain sequences do not establish separate feeding/wind thermodynamics
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass solar masses, time yr, luminosity solar luminosities in tables
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Do not equate prescribed net gain with a resolved simultaneous two-stream flow; do not mistake analytically extrapolated late evolution for a completed stellar run.

prescriptions.title: Begelman & Dexter (2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Late-stage quasi-star structural and spectral discussion
prescriptions.assumptions: Saturated envelope assumptions and late BH-dominated evolution
prescriptions.validity: Qualitative context; not a QStarS spectral prediction
prescriptions.variables_units: CGS, solar mass where stated
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Spectral interpretation requires atmosphere microphysics absent from this solver.

prescriptions.title: Martins, Schaerer & Marques-Chaves (2026)
prescriptions.reference_location: Abstract and atmosphere-model assumptions
prescriptions.assumptions: Expanding spherical non-LTE CMFGEN atmospheres
prescriptions.validity: 5000-12000 K atmosphere models; not interior LTE closure
prescriptions.variables_units: T K, L solar luminosities
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Grey flux temperature is not a synthetic spectrum or a validated wind photosphere.

prescriptions.title: MESA technical documentation, energy equation
prescriptions.reference_location: dedt and eps_grav descriptions; MESA V section 3 Eq 8 cited there
prescriptions.assumptions: Total-energy conservation and thermodynamic consistency are distinct from resolution convergence
prescriptions.validity: Stellar evolution numerical practice
prescriptions.variables_units: e erg/g, P dyn/cm^2, V_rho cm^3/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use independent energy residuals plus mesh/time convergence. The implementation derives its own spherical discrete work identity, not a transcription of MESA.

prescriptions.title: MESA installation and upstream QUEST
prescriptions.reference_location: Prerequisites, SDK, release pinning
prescriptions.assumptions: Validated microphysics requires versioned EOS/opacity/atmosphere infrastructure
prescriptions.validity: Existing MESA 24.08.1 and ARM SDK 24.7.1 recovered from earlier runtime; local build changes recorded
prescriptions.variables_units: Not applicable
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Direct EOS and opacity calls are implemented for fixed H/He composition. Stellar evolution, atmosphere, and moving cavity production gates remain open. Report 5 corrects the earlier absence claim.

prescriptions.title: Classical ideal-gas plus radiation thermodynamics
prescriptions.reference_location: Dotan Eqs 21-23; first-law derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Nondegenerate fully ionized monatomic mixture in LTE; fixed composition
prescriptions.validity: 1e5 <= T <= 1e8 K, electron occupation < 0.1, Newtonian low compactness
prescriptions.variables_units: P dyn/cm^2, u erg/g, s erg/g/K
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Heat capacities, adiabatic exponents, and entropy derived consistently from the same EOS; arbitrary entropy zero explicitly fixed.

prescriptions.title: Electron-scattering opacity
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2.3; Thomson cross section times electrons per gram
prescriptions.assumptions: Fully ionized H/He mixture; scattering dominates; LTE/thermalization separately assumed
prescriptions.validity: Hot diffuse envelope; no bound-free/free-free/negative hydrogen/line opacity
prescriptions.variables_units: kappa=0.2(1+X) cm^2/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: No cool extrapolation admitted as validated physics. Optional external opacity tables strictly reject out-of-bounds values and require provenance.

prescriptions.title: Rosseland radiative diffusion
prescriptions.reference_location: Temperature-gradient controls; diffusion derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Optically thick LTE; F=-ac/(3 kappa rho) grad(T^4)
prescriptions.validity: Radiation gradient Knudsen number <=0.1; LTE assumed; no resolved optically thin transfer
prescriptions.variables_units: Flux erg/cm^2/s; luminosity erg/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Backward-Euler diffusion shares exactly one flux per face; grey extrapolation is an optional outer closure.

prescriptions.title: Optically thick lossless mixing-length limit
prescriptions.reference_location: ML1 reference in Section II; explicit derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Local buoyant blobs, no radiative heat leakage; l=alpha Hp
prescriptions.validity: Pe>=100 where convection carries more than 1 percent of transported flux; subsonic blobs; not full ML1 or time-dependent convection
prescriptions.variables_units: cp erg/g/K; velocity cm/s; l cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Use v^2=g delta l^2 (nabla-nabla_ad)/(8Hp), F=rho cp T v l (nabla-nabla_ad)/(2Hp), capped by P cs. Entropy contrast discretized consistently.

prescriptions.title: Compatible spherical mechanical work
prescriptions.reference_location: Compatible differencing principle; QStarS derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Fixed shell masses during mechanical substep; midpoint pressure and velocity; spherical gravity quadrature
prescriptions.validity: Smooth subsonic flow; no shock validation
prescriptions.variables_units: Total energy erg; nodal velocity cm/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Secant area and 1/(r_new r_old) gravity produce exact work cancellation; no energy residual compensation. Article discovered as methodological background; full PDF not audited.

prescriptions.title: Conservative boundary source-cell closure
prescriptions.reference_location: First-law open-system derivation; compare wind Eq 3
prescriptions.assumptions: Separate mass sources/sinks at first/last cell; comoving mixing; supplied enthalpy and entropy specified
prescriptions.validity: Effective 1D boundary mixing; unresolved geometry, shocks, inflow momentum
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass g, enthalpy erg/g, entropy erg/g/K
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Differentiate discrete gravitational energy for boundary potential flux; central-potential work is separately recorded. Wind escape cost debits outward light once.

prescriptions.title: Conservative overlap remapping
prescriptions.reference_location: QStarS finite-volume derivation in docs/equations.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Piecewise constant volume and total specific energy in mass coordinates
prescriptions.validity: Smooth resolved states; remap changes entropy and hydrostatic residual
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass g, volume cm^3, energy erg
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: New internal energy is remapped total energy minus new discrete gravity and kinetic energies. Decimal overlap endpoints avoid cancellation of large cumulative CGS masses; the sweep is linear in zone count. Reject negative internal energy; log entropy changes.

prescriptions.title: MESA 24.08.1 EOS and opacity public APIs
prescriptions.reference_location: eosDT_get, kap_get; eos_def quantity definitions; source commit 5c166bf174b477823a2ca0031c4f57210c8e67a8
prescriptions.assumptions: Fixed H1/He4 composition Z=0; default EOS blends and Type2 opacity with Zbase=0; matched electron state
prescriptions.validity: Query rectangle rho=1e-14..1e3 g/cm3 and T=3000..1e8 K is only a bounding box. Reject neutral ideal backstop and first-law defect above 1 percent; no production atmosphere claim.
prescriptions.variables_units: P erg/cm3, u erg/g, s erg/g/K, kappa cm2/g; derivatives with respect to natural logarithms
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Versioned C ABI and Python interface cross-checked against separate Fortran process. Wide audit preserves failing blend states. Radiative opacity disables conduction; a separate combined-opacity call measures omitted conduction. Existing binary/build/table provenance must accompany each run.

prescriptions.title: Inverse radiative/convective flux solve
prescriptions.reference_location: Algebraic derivation in docs/equations.md, using existing diffusion and lossless MLT equations
prescriptions.assumptions: Same physical closure as forward flux; luminosities retained as nonlinear unknowns; active-piece complex-step derivatives
prescriptions.validity: Smooth subsonic hot envelopes; transport validity unchanged by nonlinear method
prescriptions.variables_units: L erg/s, logarithmic thermal contrast dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Solving thermal contrast from luminosity avoids ill conditioning near adiabatic stratification; no transport coefficient changed. Numerical reference is QStarS derivation, not copied MESA implementation.

prescriptions.title: Levermore & Pomraning (1981)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section II, Eqs 7 and 18-31; pp321-324
prescriptions.assumptions: Near LTE and slowly varying radiation energy over a mean free path; no flux-limiter implementation added
prescriptions.validity: R=|grad E|/(kappa rho E)<=0.1, using E=aT^4. Cell optical depth remains a diagnostic, not a mesh-dependent validity restriction.
prescriptions.variables_units: R dimensionless, photon mean free path cm
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Corrects prior tau_cell>=1 rejection, which incorrectly rejected increasingly fine representations of a smooth diffusive field. R<=0.1 is a conservative screening threshold, not a proof of full atmosphere validity.

prescriptions.title: Conservative backward-Euler mechanical work
prescriptions.reference_location: Independent derivation in docs/equations.md; not copied MESA code
prescriptions.assumptions: Implicit velocity and pressure with secant geometry/gravity; positive numerical kinetic heating retained as internal conversion
prescriptions.validity: Smooth secular evolution; first order, requires timestep refinement; not a pulsation solver
prescriptions.variables_units: Q_i=dm_i[(Delta v_i)^2+(Delta v_i+1)^2]/4 erg
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Diagnostic heating is derived from momentum work and never from a global energy residual. It is excluded from the external ledger balance. Both midpoint and backward_euler are explicit selectable numerical methods.

prescriptions.title: MESA 24.08.1 atmosphere and native MLT
prescriptions.reference_location: atm_T_tau_varying.f90; atm_T_tau_uniform.f90; turb set_mlt and mlt.f90
prescriptions.assumptions: Eddington T(tau); native fixed/varying opacity; Henyey or ML1 with alpha=2 explicit, Henyey nu=8 and y=1/3
prescriptions.validity: Native varying atmosphere starts with rho_outer=1e-10; inappropriate as an implicit vacuum boundary at low gravity. MLT subsonic validity checked separately.
prescriptions.variables_units: tau dimensionless, Pg dyn/cm2, v cm/s; native automatic derivatives
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: At Teff=8000 K, g=3 and kappa=.34, native varying constant-opacity photospheric Pg is 78.96 times the analytic vacuum value. Native MLT availability is not a validated coupled stellar model.

prescriptions.title: Irwin FreeEOS 3.0.0 (2022)
prescriptions.reference_location: mod_free_eos modern API; EOS1 (3,11,-2); mod_free_eos_constants and mod_isotopic_mass_data
prescriptions.assumptions: Free-energy minimization for LTE H1/He4, gas-only evaluation followed by explicit blackbody radiation; no EOS fitting or stitching
prescriptions.validity: 153-state component audit is not global EOS certification or non-LTE atmosphere validation. Upstream byte comparisons fail; physical reference fields quantified separately.
prescriptions.variables_units: CGS; derivatives in ln rho and ln T; energy zero from upstream
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Source tar SHA256 4ab1c15a51385a3eab3b08c6f3f240739c0105d92ec828d635ac95720edefb09. ARM portability patch removes duplicate extended/quadruple generic declarations after compiler-kind check; physical formulae unchanged. GPL dependency separately installed.

prescriptions.title: Finite-pressure grey and MLT outer-layer reference
prescriptions.reference_location: Eddington grey relation and hydrostatic first-law derivation in docs/atmosphere.md; native Henyey implementation
prescriptions.assumptions: Plane-parallel hydrostatic layer, grey radiative atmosphere to tau=2/3, diffusion plus native MLT below; external Pg explicit
prescriptions.validity: No spherical transfer, non-LTE populations, moving mass, wind coupling or physical disruption claim. Geometric thickness and supersonic convection veto promotion.
prescriptions.variables_units: dP/dtau=g/kappa, dT/dtau=(T/P)*nabla*g/kappa; column mass g/cm2, energy erg/cm2
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Integrate explicit gas pressure and subtract radiation-pressure gradient; retain depth, mass and energy inventories. Constant opacity has analytic check. Report 10 stops at the first resolved convective Mach-one crossing with a structured validity-domain exit; no supersonic profile is returned. The archived Report 8 continuation remains an invalid diagnostic, not a closure.

prescriptions.title: Dilute classical-gas limit for H/He
prescriptions.reference_location: Ideal-gas limit Pg=rho kT/(mu m_u); Debye-Huckel weak-coupling and nondegeneracy screening
prescriptions.assumptions: H/He only, T>=40000 K, eta<-10 and conservative charge-2 Coulomb Gamma<.01
prescriptions.validity: A 1% dilute-gas discrepancy is a rejection threshold, not a correction or global EOS accuracy claim
prescriptions.variables_units: Gamma and relative Pg defect dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Radiation-dominated total first-law agreement can conceal significant gas-pressure error. The historical MESA table discrepancy is retained and rejected in evolution when the dilute limit applies; its radiation-scaled origin is an inference, not a proven table-generation bug.

prescriptions.title: Nakauchi et al. (2017)
prescriptions.reference_location: Section 2 equations 1-9, Section 3 Figure 2
prescriptions.assumptions: Smooth stationary spherical LTE gas plus radiation, negligible wind self-gravity, no wind convection; direct FreeEOS and MESA opacity differ from original microphysics
prescriptions.validity: Stop strict calculations at radiation-gradient Knudsen 0.1 or a second sonic approach. Paper photosphere extension is diagnostic only. No terminal escape or coupled evolution certification.
prescriptions.variables_units: r cm, rho g/cm3, T K, v cm/s, mdot g/s, L erg/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Gas sonic regularity fixes critical luminosity and local accelerating slope. Base matching solves for sonic r,rho,T without supplied mdot. Independent momentum, diffusion and first-law quadratures supplement exact flux algebra. Published profile discrepancies retained without fitting.

prescriptions.title: Quataert et al. (2016)
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2-3; steady equations and trapped-radiation wind regime
prescriptions.assumptions: Near-surface energy deposition; nearly adiabatic trapped radiation; convection not automatically the dominant transport
prescriptions.validity: Not a generic recombining photosphere or microscopic opacity replacement
prescriptions.variables_units: Heating erg/s, mass g, speed cm/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Provides a physically motivated outflow alternative when hydrostatic convection cannot carry energy; adiabatic approximation needs a photon trapping check. No new heating law added.

prescriptions.title: Owocki, Townsend & Quataert (2017)
prescriptions.reference_location: Equations 5-10; Appendices B-C
prescriptions.assumptions: Steady spherical continuum winds; gas and radiation enthalpy separated from comoving diffusion luminosity
prescriptions.validity: Constant opacity limits and simplified sonic sound speed do not solve recombination transfer
prescriptions.variables_units: Luminosity erg/s, enthalpy erg/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Confirms energy partition and the distinction between observer luminosity and diffusive luminosity. Do not charge wind energy from emergent radiation alone.

prescriptions.title: Owocki, Gayley & Shaviv (2004)
prescriptions.reference_location: Porosity-length and power-law porosity models
prescriptions.assumptions: Effective opacity from unresolved inhomogeneities; porosity length and distribution are physical closure inputs
prescriptions.validity: No unique first-principles porosity parameter for these quasi-star boundaries
prescriptions.variables_units: Porosity length cm, optical depths dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: A defensible alternative family with explicit parameters, not permission to fit an opacity reduction to a failing smooth-wind benchmark. Kept separate from Dotan launch and Fiacconi radiation wind.

prescriptions.title: Jiang et al. (2015)
prescriptions.reference_location: 3D radiation hydrodynamics; optically efficient and inefficient convection regimes
prescriptions.assumptions: Massive-star radiation-dominated iron-opacity layers, multidimensional density and flux correlations
prescriptions.validity: Different composition and opacity peak from primordial quasi-stars; cannot transplant a calibrated coefficient without testing
prescriptions.variables_units: Optical depth and convective Mach dimensionless
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Supports checking diffusion time versus dynamical time and forbids assuming supersonic local MLT remains valid. Does not prove a universal no-go for 1D quasi-stars.

prescriptions.title: MESA historical OPAL / Alexander-Ferguson opacity audit
prescriptions.reference_location: kap_get_radiative_opacity; kap controls; Nakauchi section 2.1
prescriptions.assumptions: Type1 OPAL gs98 or gn93 above 7000 K; MESA lowT_af94_gn93 below; X=.7, Z=0; native interpolation
prescriptions.validity: Common table rectangle logR=-7..1, T=3000..1e7 K; Rosseland mean only, no flux-mean or non-LTE inference
prescriptions.variables_units: kappa cm2/g; R=rho/(T/1e6)^3
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Separate native handles preserve the default opacity. MESA lowT_af94 header says Alexander & Ferguson (1995); processed tables cannot be certified identical to the authors files. No fitting of sonic inputs.

prescriptions.title: Reynolds transport for an LTE wind matching sphere
prescriptions.reference_location: QStarS derivation from Reynolds transport; stationary energy channels consistent with Owocki et al. equations 5-10
prescriptions.assumptions: Newtonian LTE isotropic radiation pressure, static central potential, lab conserved variables, specified face speed
prescriptions.validity: No automatic moving-cavity or evolving atmosphere reconstruction; conservation interface only
prescriptions.variables_units: mass g/s, momentum dyn, energy erg/s, face speed cm/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Relative enthalpy advection plus P*A*face_speed work equals fixed flux minus swept conserved density. Tested against independently integrated swept volumes and an energy-gauge shift.

prescriptions.title: Hummer & Rybicki (1971)
prescriptions.reference_location: Equations 2.1-2.31, Table I final iteration; PDF SHA256 05fdb069368c1b2885358203a6b84dc85eb41eb6e0e4c6026ba17b16f936be20
prescriptions.assumptions: Static spherical conservative isotropic grey transfer with computed variable Eddington factor
prescriptions.validity: Declared grey extinction only; no non-grey H/He flux mean, thermalization or non-LTE inference
prescriptions.variables_units: J,H,K bolometric intensities; chi inverse length; net central luminosity
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Independent published moment table, angular flux, diffusion and streaming limits plus boundary/grid refinement. Finite inner diffusion boundary is checked, never silently treated as the exact infinite-depth condition.

prescriptions.title: Fukue (2018)
prescriptions.reference_location: Equations 3-14 and grey scattering moment equations; public indexed primary article
prescriptions.assumptions: Isotropic coherent scattering in the comoving frame; frequency-independent specified extinction, no true absorption or material energy equation
prescriptions.validity: Outward v/c <= .01 in tested moment solver; no ionization or gas temperature prediction
prescriptions.variables_units: D=[gamma(1-mu beta)]^-1; lab source D^4 J0; extinction chi0/D
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Conservative moving moments closed by angular rays; incoming core light absorbed and isotropic emitted intensity determined by net luminosity. Published relativistic figure families are not claimed reproduced.

prescriptions.title: Owocki, Townsend & Quataert (2017) flux-driven limit
prescriptions.reference_location: Equation 24 and 26; finite initial kinetic energy generalization independently derived
prescriptions.assumptions: Constant grey opacity, no gas pressure/enthalpy; analytic reference neglects radiation drag, numerical wind includes moving transfer
prescriptions.validity: Mathematical continuum control, supplied mdot and vbase. Not a thermodynamic primordial quasi-star wind or an envelope match.
prescriptions.variables_units: w=v^2/vesc^2, x=1-R/r, m=mdot GM/(R L0), Gamma=L0/Ledd
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: No coefficient fits. Compare velocity, density, luminosity, force and photospheric diagnostic, energy and momentum; high-drag negative control must not be interpreted through the small-drag analytic approximation.

prescriptions.title: Public stationary-wind and transfer candidate audit
prescriptions.reference_location: Pinned SIROCCO, MPI-AMRVAC and DUSTY source paths, model inputs and hashes in candidate_source_files.json
prescriptions.assumptions: Availability ranked separately from physical correspondence; prescribed flow, line driving and dust driving remain different families
prescriptions.validity: No installed/coupled non-LTE or dust/line wind claim
prescriptions.variables_units: Each candidate records equations, EOS, opacity, radiation, sonic and boundary conditions, composition, M/R/L and available outputs
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Constructed analytic continuum control chosen for exact reproducibility; public transfer packages remain candidates for closing missing gas/radiation microphysics, not substitutes for a solved launch.

prescriptions.title: Sander et al. (2017) hydrodynamically consistent PoWR
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2-5, critical condition and mass-loss update; PDF hash in Report 12 acquisition
prescriptions.assumptions: Coupled non-LTE populations, comoving-frame transfer and hydrodynamic iteration; atmospheric inner optical depth is a matching constraint
prescriptions.validity: O/WR-star examples have metals, line driving and explicit turbulence/clumping choices; not primordial quasi-star calibration
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass loss g/s, opacity per mass, material temperature K, radiative acceleration cm/s2
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: A single critical-point condition is insufficient without consistent inner radiation/thermodynamic constraints and the force response to density. No published PoWR quasi-star run claimed.

prescriptions.title: Mayer & Duschl (2005) primordial mean opacities
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections on Rosseland, Planck continuum and line means; conclusion; cached paper
prescriptions.assumptions: Primordial H/He plus trace D/Li, equilibrium populations; Planck continuum and line sets differ
prescriptions.validity: Single-temperature means do not determine the absorption energy mean or flux mean for arbitrary escaping spectra
prescriptions.variables_units: rho g/cm3, temperature K, opacity cm2/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Paper states full tables available from authors on request. No complete table or non-LTE atom installed by this campaign; trace-Li convention differs from current X=.7 Y=.3 mixture.

prescriptions.title: Malygin et al. (2014) two-temperature Planck means
prescriptions.reference_location: Sections 2-4, equilibrium-temperature degeneracy; cached PDF
prescriptions.assumptions: LTE chemical populations and high-resolution opacity spectrum; gas and illuminating radiation temperatures distinct
prescriptions.validity: Published metallicities -0.3, 0,+0.3 dex are not primordial; multiple thermal roots possible when opacity depends on state
prescriptions.variables_units: Tgas, Trad K; Planck/Rosseland cm2/g
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Demonstrates why a Rosseland-only backend is insufficient and why a unique frozen-coefficient thermal root is not evidence for unique real-gas equilibria.

prescriptions.title: Spherical frequency-band thermal transfer verification
prescriptions.reference_location: Standard static transfer and Kirchhoff source; exact chord and thin power-law limits derived in QStarS
prescriptions.assumptions: Specified constant opacity within each band, isotropic coherent scattering, static material energy equilibrium
prescriptions.validity: No state-dependent H/He opacity, statistical populations, moving frequency shifts or mechanical energy coupling
prescriptions.variables_units: J,H,K band integrated intensities; photon-temperature edges h nu/k in K
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Temperature is solved from absorption/emission balance; Planck, radiation-energy, flux and Rosseland means remain distinct. Independent luminosity/heating integral is never renormalized.

prescriptions.title: Material energy equation and adiabatic Parker eigenvalue control
prescriptions.reference_location: Parker polytropic family; independent local first-law elimination in docs/self_selected_outer.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Finite local thermal source without explicit velocity-gradient dependence; caloric ideal gamma between 1 and 1.5 for exact reference; fixed point gravity
prescriptions.validity: Reference is not H/He nor radiation escape. Isothermal/diffusive prescribed-gradient critical equations are distinct limits
prescriptions.variables_units: mdot g/s selected from base rho,P,M,r; local Q erg/cm3/s
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Gas-only FreeEOS energy derivatives yield the native gas adiabatic sound speed. Reference root interval and hydrostatic alternative have an explicit scoped proof.

prescriptions.title: General lab radiation moments at a moving matching face
prescriptions.reference_location: Reynolds transport derivation in docs/self_selected_outer.md; not an LTE closure
prescriptions.assumptions: Newtonian material and realizable lab radiation moments, same static potential and gas energy gauge
prescriptions.validity: Zero-thickness flux jumps only; finite layers require storage, gravity and curvature; no entropy continuity imposed
prescriptions.variables_units: Mass g/s, momentum dyn, energy erg/s; E erg/cm3, F erg/cm2/s, Prr dyn/cm2
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Subtract swept gas and radiation energy/momentum. Radiation enthalpy is already in lab flux. Independent normal-shock and energy-gauge controls.

prescriptions.title: Hillier CMFGEN public distribution and supplied models
prescriptions.reference_location: 18-Jun-2025 source, 21-Jun-2023 atomic data, 22-Jun-2023 reference models; native source and documentation inspected
prescriptions.assumptions: Spherical comoving NLTE transfer, statistical atoms, specified flow; option-dependent advection, thermal and scattering physics
prescriptions.validity: H/He hot test is not a cool quasi-star, eigenvalue or complete evolution. Executable exit zero is not proof of completion or convergence.
prescriptions.variables_units: Native R in 1e10cm, T in 1e4K, V km/s, nu in 1e15Hz; FQW already Hz; spectral adapter cgs
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Archive/per-file hashes, GPLv3 source, native arm64 build, opt-in read-only spectrum export; reference, moment, atomic-accounting and energy gates remain separate.

prescriptions.title: PoWR public source availability
prescriptions.reference_location: Commit b7cb9d27e4970e67de83f9e166476f46b4af7f45; README, Makefile and tree inventory
prescriptions.assumptions: Spherical NLTE stellar atmosphere; Intel Fortran/MKL build; GPLv3
prescriptions.validity: Retrieved repository lacks the atomic/reference input package needed for this reproduction; no assertion that those inputs are nowhere available
prescriptions.variables_units: Native conventions require independent interface audit
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Resolves earlier public-source uncertainty. Strong physical alternative; published hydroconsistent method not assumed identical to every public code revision.

prescriptions.title: SIROCCO radiative transfer modes and macro-atoms
prescriptions.reference_location: Sobolev approximation, hybrid macro-atom, scattering and comoving energy sections; repository pin in audit
prescriptions.assumptions: Moving Monte Carlo flow, all line transfer Sobolev, option-dependent atomic and energy treatments
prescriptions.validity: Weak-gradient launch and optically thick thermalization require their own validation; exterior transfer does not supply a sonic eigenvalue
prescriptions.variables_units: Photon energy and frequency frames; force estimators require uncertainty/seed accounting
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Not selected merely because previously mentioned; physical launch coverage and variance favored a deterministic comoving operator.

prescriptions.title: Osborne and Milic (2021), Lightweaver
prescriptions.reference_location: Formal solver geometry and extensible atomic/atmosphere interfaces; public MIT source
prescriptions.assumptions: Multilevel NLTE in plane-parallel 1D or Cartesian 2D public solvers
prescriptions.validity: Spherical moving wind and material-energy coupling require additional implementation
prescriptions.variables_units: Level populations, intensities and rate coefficients require explicit atom configuration
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Useful independent atomic/static comparison; not a ready spherical launch backend.

prescriptions.title: RH spherical source implementation restriction
prescriptions.reference_location: Commit c95bdf66ff6bc1c6cea0ed04dc688100170e8ee6: rhsphere/readatmos.c and formal.c
prescriptions.assumptions: Static spherical non-LTE transfer implementation
prescriptions.validity: Source explicitly rejects macroscopic spherical flows and angle-dependent moving opacity
prescriptions.variables_units: Velocity and opacity checks in native source
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Restriction established from source, not assumed from project age or popularity. License unresolved in this audit.

prescriptions.title: Ferland et al. (2017), Cloudy
prescriptions.reference_location: Photoionization, atomic and thermal calculations; candidate audit
prescriptions.assumptions: Photoionized plasma, extensive atomic data and escape-probability line methods
prescriptions.validity: Not a complete comoving hydrodynamic launch operator
prescriptions.variables_units: Ionization fractions, temperature, heating/cooling
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Potential independent atomic/thermal reference. No local Cloudy run, timing, or license verification claimed.

prescriptions.title: CMFGEN spectral four-force and resolved H/He material energy interface
prescriptions.reference_location: Audited cmfgen_sub, comp_opac, comp_j_blank, set_frequency_grid_v2, atomic oscillator level tables; diagnostic derivation
prescriptions.assumptions: Coherent scattering, isotropic comoving material emission; ideal translational and resolved atomic energy
prescriptions.validity: Inelastic scattering rejected; no molecules, nonideal corrections, relaxed kinetic response or validated envelope/eigenvalue response; Report 14 adds frozen-population partials
prescriptions.variables_units: Q0 erg/cm3/s positive material heating; f0 dyn/cm3; neutral H/He ground energy gauge; mean/clump densities distinct
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Independent spectral quadrature is a conversion check, not independent atomic-physics certification. LTE FreeEOS derivatives cannot be reused without a population-response and energy-gauge bridge.

prescriptions.title: CMFGEN H-minus and neutral-hydrogen Rayleigh implementation audit
prescriptions.reference_location: 18-Jun-2025 cmfgen_sub, comp_opac, do_var_cont, rayleigh_scat; atomic HYD/MI/13apr15
prescriptions.assumptions: Negative ion H0 precedes HI; Rayleigh opacity is a neutral-H ground-state process
prescriptions.validity: H-minus supplied col_guess remains an uncertainty; component call-site test does not certify the full cool atmosphere
prescriptions.variables_units: Native opacity in inverse 1e10 cm; ion names, full-level strides, population equation indices
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Name-based population export and corrected HI Rayleigh call/Jacobian; original failure retained; no rate or cross-section fitting

prescriptions.title: Extended-state ideal H-/H/He material differential
prescriptions.reference_location: Atomic oscillator energies and charges; ideal-mixture first-law derivation in docs/nlte_cool_closure.md
prescriptions.assumptions: Independent level numbers per gram, charge-neutral electrons, fixed nuclear composition
prescriptions.validity: Frozen population partials only; no relaxed non-LTE response, entropy/free-energy completion, molecules or nonideal terms
prescriptions.variables_units: cgs gas P/u; d/dlnrho and d/dlnT at fixed populations per gram; neutral H/He ground energy zero
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Ionization, excitation, H-minus detachment and particle-creation terms enter du once. No graft of LTE EOS derivatives or blackbody radiation into the material state.

prescriptions.title: CMFGEN H-minus free-free cooling/opacity/Jacobian audit
prescriptions.reference_location: 18-Jun-2025 do_h0_ff, genopaeta_v10, var_op_v10, comp_free_free_v2 and solveba_v13; HYD/MI/13apr15/hmi_ff
prescriptions.assumptions: Tabulated neutral-H ground-state/electron free-free opacity; existing native log interpolation and stimulated convention
prescriptions.validity: Four-frequency component probe at 3300/6100/11300 K; not a full atomic-rate validation, relaxed material response or cool atmosphere certificate
prescriptions.variables_units: T in 1e4 K, nu in 1e15 Hz, chi in inverse 1e10 cm; physical population partials and native cooling sign
prescriptions.implementation_interpretation: Lazy initialization from cooling and opacity; correct last-depth selection; analytic T/ne/ground-H partials and EHB consistency; all-level stopping; no coefficient or rate fit
